elements.caption: Controls a Sony Bravia TV over the network. The TV has to be prepared once, see the notes at the fields.
IP address of the TV, not a host name. A fixed address is recommended.

Pre-Shared Key: a key of your choice that the TV expects with every command. On the TV under Network & Internet → Local network → IP control (menu names differ between TV generations), set the authentication to 'Pre-Shared Key' (or 'Normal and Pre-Shared Key') and enter the key. Enter the same key here (default 0000). Also switch on 'Remote start' there, otherwise the TV cannot be switched on from standby. With a wrong key the TV still reports its power state, but the lists stay empty and commands fail with error 403 (Forbidden). The module recognises this by itself with every request that needs the key (cyclic update while the TV is on, reading the lists, commands) and sets the instance to status 203; the self test checks the key at any time.

Picture settings: one variable per setting the TV reports (brightness, contrast, sharpness, colour temperature …) with the range or the values of the TV. They apply to the current input and picture mode and are read and changed only while the TV is on.

actions.caption: Checks the settings, reachability, Pre-Shared Key and lists and shows the result. The first step when something does not work.

Switching the variable PowerStatus: 2 = On; 0 (Off / not reachable) and 1 (Standby) both put the TV into standby, it cannot be switched fully off over the network. The value 0 is only shown when the TV does not answer.

Script functions with their parameters: STV_SetPowerStatus($InstanceID, true = on / false = standby), STV_SetInputSource($InstanceID, '<title as in the options of InputSource, e.g. HDMI 2>'), STV_StartApplication($InstanceID, '<title as in the options of Application, e.g. Netflix>'), STV_SendRemoteKey($InstanceID, '<key name as in the options of SendRemoteKey, e.g. Home>'), STV_SetSpeakerVolume($InstanceID, <0 to 100>), STV_SetHeadphoneVolume($InstanceID, <0 to 100>), STV_SetAudioMute($InstanceID, true = muted / false), STV_UpdateAll($InstanceID). All return true when the TV confirmed the command, otherwise false with a warning.

For scripts: STV_RunSelfTest($InstanceID) returns the self test as text (configuration, reachability, Pre-Shared Key, lists; one line per check, last line 'N errors, M warnings') and switches nothing. The buttons below are IPS_RequestAction($InstanceID, '<Ident>', 0) with the idents UpdateStatusVariables, UpdateLists (all three lists; single lists: UpdateRemoteKeyList, GetSourceListInfo, UpdateApplicationList) and WriteAPIInformationToFile; they return false with a warning on failure. The lists themselves are the options of the variables SendRemoteKey, InputSource and Application; STV_ReadApplicationList($InstanceID) returns the apps as JSON.

Picture settings (switch 'Create variables for the picture settings'): ident 'Picture' plus the setting of the TV, e.g. PictureSharpness (integer, range as in the slider) or PictureColorTemperature (string, values as in the options, e.g. 'warm'). Switch them with RequestAction while the TV is on. A variable without action is not available for the current input or picture mode.
Queries the TV now and updates the status variables. With interval 0 the module does not query the TV regularly.

The module reads the apps, inputs and remote keys of the TV by itself when the settings are applied, and catches up as soon as the TV is reachable. Reading them again is only needed after an app has been installed or removed on the TV or an input has been renamed.

items.caption: Creates the file 'Sony <model>.txt' in the Symcon log directory with all functions the TV knows. It is only needed for support requests or for extending the module.
